question: Manu printed 20 books of 200 pages each. The cost of printing is Rs. 25 per page. After this, he spent Rs. 80 per book on binding. After this, he spent Rs. 2,000 on advertising the books and Rs. 50 per book in supply. If at the end he sold each book for Rs. 7500, then find the amount gained (profit) by Manu.

Number of books = 20

Selling price per book = 7500
